All scene circumstances, palette values, area roles, pattern placement, role and camera treatment below are agent_visual_choice synthetic test conditions, not requester definitions or protected palette locks. I compared a display-only bench still life with a present packing action; the packing action makes the object, hands and ready cradle causally connected. WHO is a fictional model conservator preserving a repaired model; WHERE is a maritime model workshop with a loading cradle; HOW is an observational three-quarter view close enough for appearance and distinct materials; WHY NOW is the transfer from repaired support pad to transport. Subtle supporting attraction is expressed by quiet poise and the warm proximity of a focused face, under sensual=1; fetish=0 and surreal=0 add no treatment. This independently sampled boat-packing direction uses restrained creativity=1.

Photograph a complex working scene with color and material relationships made visibly readable in a maritime model workshop during exhibition loading. A woman with the supplied photograph's visible facial appearance and hair is the model conservator: preserve the visible facial proportions, brown eyes, short dark bob and light wispy bangs. Her fictional role and circumstances are invented for this photograph. She is guiding a repaired boat model into a fitted open carrying cradle. The hull has just cleared a folded support pad, and the shaped recess waits directly beneath it; a detached display-label holder and the pad lie beside the cradle, making the change from repair bench to transport legible. Her right hand cups the stern underside and her left palm supports the bow underside, both hands connected to relaxed bent forearms as she leans a little over the bench. Her feet stand on the workshop floor; the cradle rests flat on the table. Her attention follows the narrow gap below the hull, with quiet poise and a soft, absorbed expression. Color belongs to each identifiable object's own surface, and material remains a separate visible property. The large work apron is aubergine violet matte woven linen, with soft diffuse shading and visible fibers at the waist folds. The boat model hull repeats aubergine violet in smooth glossy lacquer over wood; a thin pale reflection bends along its curved flank while the underlying violet pigment remains legible. An ivory painted cabin and pale wooden deck identify the repaired object as a boat model. A small ceramic hardware cup on the bench is yellow ochre under a glassy glaze, its hard rounded highlight distinct from the linen's diffuse shading and the lacquer's elongated reflection. The open collar and sleeves of her plain shirt are warm ivory cotton. These violet surfaces carry the large color areas, the ochre cup makes a smaller contrasting accent, and ivory surfaces leave breathing room around them. A small cloth work mat is woven with thin alternating violet and ivory stripes, the pattern contained within the mat's edge; the apron, hull and cup have continuous solid-color surfaces. Brushed steel repair tools and a raw pale-wood bench retain their own material colors. Broad window daylight keeps skin, ivory cloth and steel neutral, while gloss changes the highlights locally on the painted hull and glazed cup. The photograph's restrained neutral rendering lets the actual pigments carry the violet-and-ochre complementary pairing. A landscape medium-wide documentary photograph from a three-quarter position at chest height includes her face, both supporting hands, the entire boat and cradle, and enough shelving to read the model workshop. Use a natural perspective and moderate depth of field: the face, material comparison and the cradle gap remain clear, while distant stored hulls soften. The emotional center is the careful transfer of something just made whole, with the different colored surfaces supporting that one connected moment.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.

sensual.definition: Broadly interpreted human attraction and desire, including everyday, popular, intimate, suggestive, seductive, and overt expressions.

levels.0: No added sensual treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This expression is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This expression is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This expression leads the image's appeal and direction.

fetish.definition: Sexual attraction or arousal focused on particular objects, bodily features, clothing, materials, roles, situations, behaviors, or sensory qualities that carry special erotic significance, interpreted broadly beyond conventional fetish aesthetics.

levels.0: No added fetish treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This focus is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This focus is clearly readable in the image.

adult_appeal_emphasis.definition: Relative leadership of the active sensual and fetish axes within one coherent expression.

choice_descriptions.auto: Let the higher effective intensity lead; equal active intensities share leadership. Add no emphasis when both axes are inactive.
choice_descriptions.sensual_led: Let broad attraction and desire lead, with any active distinctive fascination supporting the expression.
choice_descriptions.balanced: Give both active axes comparable influence within one coherent expression; separate styling details are not required.
choice_descriptions.fetish_led: Let the distinctive focus of attraction or fascination lead, with any active sensual expression supporting it.

creativity.definition: Freedom to interpret unspecified choices and explore relationships within the request.

levels.0: Realize the request directly, filling only what is needed for a coherent image.
levels.1: Introduce restrained variations close to the requested direction.
levels.2: Actively reinterpret open choices into a coherent authorial direction.
levels.3: Boldly explore unexpected relationships and interpretations while preserving the request's core meaning.

viewer_experience.definition: Expose the detailed viewer-experience review when enabled. Always consider the intended impression in interpreted_intent, even when this additional review is off.
